_: Enchantments (ENCH / ObjectEffect). Two worked cases: (1) a custom Frost Damage MGEF -> a `weapon` enchantment -> a craftable, frost-enchanted iron sword (charge pool via enchantmentAmount). (2) a custom Fortify Stamina MGEF -> an `apparel` constant-effect enchantment -> an iron cuirass that boosts stamina while worn. The cuirass sets `template` to ArmorIronCuirass so it CLONES the iron armor's Armature (worn mesh) — a bare ARMO equips INVISIBLE (the mesh lives on ARMA addons, not the ARMO). FormIDs discovered via the CLI (find): IronSword=0x012EB7, ArmorIronCuirass=0x012E49, IronIngot=0x05ACE4, GrandSoulGem=0x02E4FC, forge keyword=0x088105. The enchantment FIRING in-game is structurally-built but NOT in-game-confirmed (I can't run Skyrim).

magicEffects.description: Target takes frost damage to Health and Stamina.
